name: Incubus
summary: A fiend that charms and drains victims with its touch and nightmares, and can take a succubus form.

traits.name: Succubus Form
traits.text: When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a **{ref:creature/succubus}**, using that stat block instead of this one. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The incubus makes two Restless Touch attacks.

actions.name: Restless Touch
actions.onHit: and the target is cursed for 24 hours or until the incubus dies. Until the curse ends, the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests.

bonusActions.name: Nightmare

save.targets: one creature the incubus can see within 60 feet

bonusActions.onFailure: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Otherwise, the target takes {dmg:4d8:psychic}.
